articles.summary: We are happy to announce that NearWave co-founder Thomas O’Sullivan was awarded first place in 1st Source Bank’s 2023 Commercialization Awards. The Commercialization Award is presented annually to faculty from the University of Notre Dame or the Indiana University School of Medicine-South Bend for exceptional research discoveries and the role they have played in supporting […]
articles.title: NearWave Co-founder Wins First Place in 1st Source Bank Commercialization Awards
